offering_description.value: Provides wireless, fixed broadband, voice and enterprise connectivity services to consumers and businesses in rural US markets and island or emerging markets in the Caribbean and South America. It runs its own networks and sells service plans through its own stores, retail partners and direct sales teams.

primary_products.value: mobile phones and devices; broadband internet access; fixed voice lines; data networking equipment

primary_services.value: wireless voice and data service; fixed broadband service; enterprise network connectivity; government network services; wholesale carrier services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individual subscribers in rural US and island markets buying mobile and home internet plans; B2B: Businesses, carriers and institutions buying connectivity, data networks and wholesale capacity

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly wireless and home broadband plans paid by consumers and businesses; product sales: mobile devices and customer premises equipment sold to subscribers; project or contract: multi-year enterprise and government network contracts; transaction or usage fees: wholesale voice, data and roaming charges paid by other carriers
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; project or contract; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Sells connectivity and communications services to end users, businesses and carriers; asset operator: Owns and operates wireless towers, fiber and network infrastructure in its markets

geography_served.value: global: US regional and national rural markets, US Virgin Islands, Guyana and other Caribbean and South American markets

specialization.value: related lines: wireless, fixed broadband, wireline voice, enterprise and wholesale connectivity sharing networks and customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated retail stores in its service territories; direct sales: sales teams selling to enterprise and government accounts; third-party retail: independent retail outlets selling prepaid and postpaid plans; online: company websites for plan sign-up and account management
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: telecom licenses and spectrum rights from the FCC and national regulators in the Caribbean and Guyana

notes: Market footprint and segment mix may have changed; current operating markets should be verified.
